_why: XbSymbolDatabase does not cover XMV, the video library, so these
addresses had no names and could not be replaced by name.
scripts/section_calls.py finds eight calls crossing into the XMV section
(0x001DBD00..0x00203D1C). Create, Destroy and GetStreamInfo sit at the
same offsets into the section as Future Perfect's and Black's (+0x10D,
+0x651, +0x735); the rest moved between XDK builds and are named from
how the player code at 0x00188930..0x00189740 calls them. See

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackCreate
symbols._note: 0x001DBE0D, from 0x00188E21: (4, path built by sub_0019D700 into the player at +0x24, &handle at the player's +0).

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackGetStreamInfo
symbols._note: 0x001DC435, from 0x00188946. The caller reads width and height from +0 and +4 and the audio stream count from +0xC (capped at 6) into its +0xA4.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackGetAudioStreamInfo
symbols._note: 0x001DC451, from 0x00188F4B in a loop over the audio stream count: (handle, index, &info).

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackCreateAudioStream
symbols._note: 0x001DC4E9, from 0x00188F8C, once per audio stream: (handle, index, 0, info or NULL, &stream).

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackStart
symbols._note: 0x001DC668, from 0x0018924B, with the handle, before the first Update.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackUpdate
symbols._note: 0x001DC833, from 0x00189269 and 0x001892C0: (handle, one of the D3DSurfaces the player embeds at +0xB0 in 0x18-byte steps, &status, 0).

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackGetCurrentTime
symbols._note: 0x001DCEB0, from 0x001892CC after each Update: QueryPerformanceCounter minus a start time at the playback's +0xB0, divided by a rate computed at start-up; the result goes to the player's +0x110.
